newsitem.title: USA: Berg & Berg to take control of Mission West.
newsitem.headline: Berg & Berg to take control of Mission West.

text.p: Mission West Properties on Tuesday said it reached an definitive agreement to sell six million shares of newly issued common stock to a group led by Berg & Berg Enterprises Inc.
The deal would lead to the acquisition of a majority of Mission West's shares by Berg, which owns about 3.5 million feet of commercial real estate in the South San Francisco Bay area.

Under the agreement, the Berg group will invest $900,000, or $0.15 a share, in Mission West. Prior to closing of the deal, Mission West will make a cash distribution to its shareholders other than members of the Berg group.
The distribution amount will be determined after a special meeting of shareholders but in no event will it exceed $3.20 per share.

Once the deal is completed, the Berg group will control about 80 percent of Mission West's common stock. It will designate new members of the Mission West board of directors. All current directors and officers of Mission West will resign at that time.
